channel.title: Ethiopia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Ethiopia, every source cited.

item.title: Ethiopian PM trains ministers in military drills
item.description: Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed said armed forces discipline can help build stronger leaders and advance the country's development.

item.title: Drone strikes kill 25 civilians in Ethiopia
item.description: Witnesses report multiple drone attacks in Amhara and Tigray regions since Thursday, hitting a camp for displaced people.

item.title: Ethiopian gunfire heard as thousands flee into Kenya
item.description: Over 36,000 people have crossed into Kenya from Ethiopia due to ongoing fighting.

item.title: Ethiopia backs UAE diplomat for UN chief role
item.description: Addis Ababa welcomes Lana Nusseibeh's candidacy, citing her experience and commitment to global cooperation.
